title: How often the lobby is polished
passage:
How often do the cleaners polish the lobby floor?
A. They leave the supplies behind the counter.
B. Polish is sold in the shop next door.
C. Usually once a month.
passageZh:
清潔人員多久會替大廳地板拋光一次？
A. 他們把用品放在櫃台後面。
B. 隔壁店有賣地板亮光劑。
C. 通常一個月一次。
